first-steps.title: Simple: rotations
first-steps.note: One wheel rotation ≈ 17.6 cm, so 70 cm ≈ 4 rotations.

square.title: Simple: one block per side
square.note: Forward 50 cm (2.84 rotations), quarter turn left (193 motor degrees), four times.

garage.title: Simple: rotations
garage.note: Forward about 105 cm, quarter turn left, forward about 65 cm (measure on the grid).

garage.title: Exact: degrees
garage.note: The same path with distances converted to motor degrees.

garage.title: With the ultrasonic sensor
garage.note: After the turn, drive until the back wall is 8 cm away: no need to measure the last distance.

touch-return.title: Simple: come back 4 rotations
touch-return.note: Wait until the touch sensor is pressed, stop, then drive back about 70 cm.

touch-return.title: With the timer
touch-return.note: Measure the time to the wall, then drive back for the same time.

touch-return.title: Exact: motor position
touch-return.note: Reset the motor position, then drive back exactly the degrees the motor turned.

stop-wall.title: Simple: wait until
stop-wall.note: Start moving, wait until the distance is less than 8 cm, stop.

stop-wall.title: With a loop
stop-wall.note: Keep moving forward until the distance is less than 8 cm.

corridor.title: Simple: wait until, twice
corridor.note: Drive to the first wall, turn left, drive to the second wall.

corridor.title: With loops
corridor.note: The same idea with "repeat until distance < …".

stop-line.title: Simple: wait until black
stop-line.note: Start moving, wait until the color is black, stop.

stop-line.title: With reflected light
stop-line.note: The line is dark: wait until the reflected light is less than 50.

detect-color.title: Simple: wait until blue
detect-color.note: Start moving, wait until the color is blue, stop.

detect-color.title: Roll onto the zone
detect-color.note: A short wait before "stop moving" puts the sensor well inside the blue zone.

detect-color.title: With a loop
detect-color.note: Keep moving forward until the color is blue.

line-follow.title: Simple: on / off
line-follow.note: Forever: on the dark line turn one way, on white turn the other way. It passes with 90 % (the lap takes more than 30 s: no speed bonus).

line-follow.title: Smoother: proportional
line-follow.note: The turn is proportional to the error (reflected light − 52): faster and smoother.

count-lines.title: Simple: without a variable
count-lines.note: Three times: wait until black, then until white. Then wait until black (the 4th line) and stop.

count-lines.title: With a variable
count-lines.note: Add 1 at each line (and wait for white after it) until the variable is 4.

count-lines.title: With an event
count-lines.note: "when color is black" adds 1 in another stack; the main stack waits until the variable is 4.

color-route.title: Simple: two "if"
color-route.note: Drive onto the card, then one "if" for red (left) and one for blue (right).

color-route.title: With if / else
color-route.note: Red → turn left, otherwise → turn right.

line-wall.title: Simple: wait until, twice
line-wall.note: Drive to the black line, turn right, drive until the wall is 10 cm away.

bounce.title: Simple: stop between each move
bounce.note: Repeat 3: forward until pressed, stop, back until blue, stop.

bounce.title: Without stopping
bounce.note: Change direction directly: smoother and faster.

maze.title: Simple: one block per move
maze.note: Measure each straight on the grid, quarter turns of 193 motor degrees.

maze.title: With My Blocks
maze.note: "right", "left" and "forward (cm)" blocks make the path easy to read and change.

card-lines.title: Simple: stop on the card to read it
card-lines.note: Stop on the card, set the number with one "if" per color, then count the lines until the number.

card-lines.title: Reading while driving
card-lines.note: The same without stopping: read the card on the way.

color-memory.title: Remember the first color
color-memory.note: Keep the color of the first square in a variable, then wait until the sensor sees a color that is not white and not that one.

color-memory.title: With a loop and "if"
color-memory.note: The same comparison inside a loop: when the color is different from the first one, a second variable says "found".

open-gate.title: Simple: check one direction after the other
open-gate.note: Middle open (distance > 100)? Go. Otherwise turn left and look; otherwise turn right.

open-gate.title: Compare the three distances
open-gate.note: Measure the 3 directions, keep them in variables, go where it is the largest.

line-to-wall.title: Simple: on / off
line-to-wall.note: Repeat until the wall is 10 cm away: on the line turn one way, on white the other way.

line-to-wall.title: Smoother: proportional
line-to-wall.note: The turn is proportional to the error (reflected light − 52).

sensor-maze.title: Without My Blocks
sensor-maze.note: Repeat until green: drive to the wall, turn left, if it is closed turn around to the right.

sensor-maze.title: With My Blocks
sensor-maze.note: "turn left" and "turn right" blocks keep the program short and readable.
